method: Out-of-sample forecast from 2021 using only data through 2021; compared with actual 2022-2024.

grossFlow.label: Gross-flow candidate
grossFlow.method: Historical mean gross in-migration minus population-responsive historical out-migration risk (urisk). Diagnostic candidate; not full Raps IMIG/UMIG.
grossFlow.caveat: Municipal gross flows include moves between FA municipalities. FA results are additive municipal outcomes; FA gross in/out are intentionally not reported as external FA flows.
